cases.title: Panel: New lesson on a skill with a review due opens a lesson, not the review, and never mentions one

checks.detail: first snapshot reply mode was lesson

rubric.reason: Although the snapshot shows review_due: true, the mentor opens with the ordinary intent question ('Which layer do you want to turn or grow from somewhere other than its middle, and where should it turn from...') and never mentions or offers a review.

The turn first asks as a real question which layer and where it should turn from (a corner, an edge, or the middle); the proposal of a place ('Door could swing from its left edge') comes only after, as a fallback.
The only layer named, Door, and its place (left edge) match the snapshot's proposal {layer: 'Door', suggested_place: 'middle-left'}, and no property or time is mentioned.
